Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Kavya - 12 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Shalini - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Kavya and Shalini stand near him.]

Kavya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Kavya: "Careful!"

[Tanay puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Tanay (softly): "And then?"

[Kavya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Tanay: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Kavya stand near him.]

Tanay: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay claps his hands.]

Tanay (excited): "Kavya, are you okay?"

[Tanay scratches his head.]

Shalini (happily): "How beautiful!"

[Tanay gives Mother a flower.]

Kavya: "Tanay, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Tanay stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[The mist slowly clears.]

Shalini: "I really enjoyed today."
